title: Bodies of two youths brought to Imphal amid violent protests

ai.summary: Two Kuki youths allegedly abducted and murdered in Manipur's Senapati district were recovered and brought to Imphal, triggering violent protests and a 48-hour shutdown in Kangpokpi district.

facts.claim: Two Kuki youths were allegedly abducted and murdered in Senapati district
facts.quote: the bodies of two Kuki youths who were allegedly abducted and murdered in Senapati district

facts.claim: The youths were recovered and brought to Imphal
facts.quote: The deceased, identified as Thangginlun Chongloi (21) and Paoginlal Hangsing (20), were residents of Taphou Kuki village in Kangpokpi district. Their bodies were recovered from an isolated location in neighbouring Senapati district on Sunday morning.

facts.claim: The recovery triggered violent protests in Kangpokpi district
facts.quote: The recovery of their bodies triggered violent protests in Kangpokpi district headquarters, where angry residents, mostly youths, gathered to protest against the killings and demand justice.

facts.claim: The protests led to a 48-hour shutdown in Kangpokpi district
facts.quote: The Committee on Tribal Unity (CoTU) has extended its ongoing total shutdown in Kangpokpi district for another 48 hours, citing the government’s alleged failure to take decisive action and ensure justice for the two murdered youths.

ai.background_note: The Committee on Tribal Unity (CoTU) extended its shutdown in Kangpokpi district for 48 hours following the alleged abduction and murder of two Kuki youths, demanding justice and government action.
